primaryChecks.text: They beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land each man cast his stone, and filled it. They also stopped all the springs of water and cut down all the good trees, until in Kir Hareseth all they left was its stones; however the men armed with slings went around it and attacked it.
primaryChecks.previousContext: When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land attacking the Moabites.
primaryChecks.nextContext: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, he took with him seven hundred men who drew a sword, to break through to the king of Edom; but they could not.
primaryChecks.decisionJa: 候補索引の用例と固定本文を照合し、場所との関係は文脈上の対応としてのみ扱う。
